\caption{Task~A test AUROC of cosine ranking within parts of the pooled vector. Raw: uncorrected vector; Cent.: centered on the training mean; PC1: projection onto the first component alone, where cosine reduces to a sign match; PCs 2--$D$ and PCs 1--$D$: projections onto the rest of the removed subspace and onto all of it; Retained: the ABTT output.
